In the images, the source DVD is the small square case near the center; the black object to its right appears to be a separate animal, not the DVD. The edited image removes the case and shows two white discs, while the animal remains. Refine this node’s binding/criterion to compare the source DVD’s location and identity across snapshots and assess the requested transformation on that object, rather than treating any nearby white disc as proof of success.
